name: What types of flooring can be installed in a Bay Area home?

mainEntity.name: What types of flooring can be installed in a Bay Area home?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Bay Area, common flooring options include hardwood, laminate, luxury vinyl plank (LVP), and tile. Hardwood offers durability and classic appeal, while laminate and LVP provide cost-effective, water-resistant alternatives suitable for varied climates. Tile, particularly ceramic or porcelain, is excellent for moisture-prone areas like kitchens and bathrooms. The best choice depends on your home's specific needs, budget, and desired aesthetic. We can help assess your space and recommend suitable materials.
